verdict.rationale: Orama is a search/vector database with Cloud REST APIs and SDKs, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, all probed OpenAPI/Swagger paths return 404, and Orama's own docs say the REST APIs are private, with no OpenAPI document published. The llms.txt file is an LLM-oriented docs index, not a machine-readable API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
